title: Doolittle LU Matrix Factorization
principle: A = L * U factorization with unit lower-triangular diagonal L[i][i] = 1.0.
diagonal_formula: U[i][i] = A[i][i] - sum(L[i][k] * U[k][i] for k in range(i))
off_diagonal_formula: L[j][i] = (A[j][i] - sum(L[j][k] * U[k][i] for k in range(i))) / U[i][i]
